cues: A yoga teacher in Israel explained, in all seriousness, that yoga was invented by Abraham, and that the postures come from the shapes of the Hebrew letters.
Abraham taught them to the son of one of his concubines, who went to India and taught the Indians.
A Bible verse: Abraham gave the sons of his concubines gifts and sent them east.
What do you think these gifts were?
The joke is the leap from a gift in a verse to yoga.
